BiblicalUsage: Madness in Scripture is sometimes a mask and sometimes a judgment. David played the mad man before Achish to save his life, and the servants asked Jehu wherefore this mad fellow came to him, but Moses warns that disobedience will make Israel mad for the sight of their eyes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe madness can be a mask, a mockery, or a curse, and only God knows which one He is looking at.
